runs.text: On a busy hotline, the guest cannot see how many other calls you are juggling, and they should not have to. What they feel is simply whether you listened and whether you got their order right. This is where active listening earns its keep, because repeating the order back is the easiest way to catch a mistake before it reaches the kitchen. A calm voice and an accurate read-back can make even a thirty-second call feel like great service.
